traceability.description:
Create unified tests/ folder with subdirectories for unit, integration,
performance, and governance tests. All test files must be under tests/.

Configure pytest with proper testpaths, markers, and options for
CORTEX 6.0 test suite.

Provide reusable pytest fixtures for audit_logger, temp_db, sample_dag,
and mock governance rules across all test suites.

Provide YAML/JSON fixture data files for testing without external
dependencies (sample governance rules, DAG structures, tier 0 rules).

Verify pytest can discover all tests in tests/ folder using
--collect-only flag.

Design and implement SQLite schema with todo_items, execution_state,
checkpoints tables. Include version column for optimistic locking.

Implement SQLite-based StateManager with create, read, update, delete
operations for state persistence across orchestrator executions.

Implement optimistic locking using version column to prevent lost
updates in concurrent execution scenarios.

Implement checkpoint creation and restoration to support resuming
orchestration after crash or interruption.

Refactor StateManager to extract connection pooling, add context manager
support, and optimize query performance.

Enhance existing AuditLogger with correlation ID propagation to trace
operations across orchestrator executions and system boundaries.

Add methods to analyze audit logs by correlation ID, trace operations,
and find errors within a correlation trace.

Add AuditLogger methods to log phase start/end events and feature gate
validation results for audit-driven build policy.

Implement log rotation to prevent unbounded audit log growth with
configurable max file size and retention policy.

Design Trie-based router architecture with TrieNode and TrieRouter
classes, pattern tokenization strategy, and priority handling.

Implement Trie router core with insert, search, remove methods for
O(1) pattern matching across 100+ orchestrators.

Optimize Trie router for O(1) lookup with pre-compiled regex patterns,
caching, and hash-based lookup. Target <5ms for 100 orchestrators.

Integrate TrieRouter with existing pattern_router.py, maintain backward
compatibility, migrate to Trie backend.
Design and implement DAG (Directed Acyclic Graph) data structure with DAGNode, DAGEdge, and DAG classes for work tracking with >1000 node capacity
Implement DAG node operations (add, remove, update, get, has) for managing work items in the graph
Implement DAG edge operations (add, remove, get_dependencies, get_dependents) for dependency management
Implement circular dependency detection using iterative DFS to prevent invalid DAG states
Implement topological sort using Kahn's algorithm for correct execution order
Optimize DAG performance for <100ms operations on 1000+ node graphs
Design TodoOrchestrator with state machine (7 states, valid transitions) for TODO lifecycle management
Integrate DAG with StateManager for persistent TODO storage and recovery
Implement TODO CRUD operations with state validation
Implement state transition validation with audit logging
Implement parallel task identification for concurrent execution opportunities
Implement checkpoint creation with full DAG and state snapshot
Implement checkpoint recovery with state restoration and validation
Implement rollback mechanism to restore state before failed operations
Implement YAML to TODO conversion for plan ingestion
Implement execution queue with priority ordering for task scheduling
Implement progress tracking API with percentage, ETA, and task counts
Full TODO lifecycle integration test covering YAML load through completion
